case_analysis.apparent_benchmark_claim: The case appears to claim success when the agent updates Jose Harrison's Spotify road-trip playlist according to the roommate text-message suggestions for task `042a9fc_1`.
case_analysis.actual_checked_outcome: Under the pinned AppWorld runtime, `Task.load` reads this task's `specs.json`, `GroundTruth.load` reads the task's ground truth files, and `evaluate_task` compares the task-input start state against that experiment/task's retained task-output DB state. The released evaluator then scores only the five registered `with test(...)` requirements in `official/ground_truth/evaluation.py`: answer equals the ground-truth answer, changed-model names equal `{spotify.PlaylistSong}`, added PlaylistSong `song_id` set equals `to_add_song_ids`, removed PlaylistSong `song_id` set equals `to_remove_song_ids`, and all added/removed playlist IDs equal `playlist_id`. Released success is exactly `TestTracker.pass_count == TestTracker.num_tests`.
case_analysis.target_construction_review: The official target construction is `answer.json == null` plus `private_data.playlist_id == 654`, `private_data.to_add_song_ids == [145,136,305,111]`, and `private_data.to_remove_song_ids == [167,185,215,6,173,113]`.
case_analysis.evaluator_oracle_review: The evaluator operationalizes the playlist-update outcome through set-based `spotify.PlaylistSong` diffs. It assigns `test.task_completed = active_tasks[0].status == "success"`, but that attribute is outside any registered `with test(...)` block and therefore does not affect `passes`, `failures`, `num_tests`, or `success`. Because the add/remove checks use `set_of(...)`, the evaluator is weaker than an exact multiset/directive-by-directive check.
case_analysis.reward_wiring_aggregation_review: `run_official_job` calls `evaluate_task`, serializes the resulting `TestTracker`, and writes `native_evaluator_output.json`; `run_summary.json` copies `tracker.success` into `success`; the post-score join reads each same-record `native_evaluator_output.json::tracker.success` and maps `true -> success`, `false -> fail`. `Metric` only reports aggregates and does not alter any individual record's `TestTracker.success`.

official_benchmark_assessment.description: The copied official case artifact is not internally consistent with the pinned released runtime: `official/specs.json` says `db_version` `0.1.0`, while the pinned runtime sets `DB_VERSION = 0.2.0` and `evaluate_task` hard-fails when `task.db_version != DB_VERSION`. That means the copied source-only case artifact is not self-consistent as the exact runnable task spec for the pinned evaluator closure.

checklist_and_case_packet_assessment.description: The frozen checklist preserves every and only the five official registered tests, preserves their conjunction, keeps the unscored `task_completed` attribute out of native scoring, and places the multiplicity gap in stronger rather than native.
